notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine, paying {2} to copy the Dockside Extortionist trigger.
Resolve the copy, creating six Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens, tapping two Treasure tokens to untap Lithoform Engine.
Sacrifice two Treasure tokens for {2}.
Aetherworks Marvel triggers twice, adding {E}{E}.
Repeat step 3 through 6.
Activate Aetherworks Marvel, paying six {E} to look at the top six cards of your library and you may cast a spell from amoung them.
activate Clock of Omens, tapping two Treasure tokens to untap Aetherworks Marvel.
Repeat steps 7 through 9.
